title: EE60046: Special Electrical Machines
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Field aspects of electrical machines: Review of Maxwell’s equations and
solution of Laplace’s and Poisson’s equations. Concept of magnetic vector
potential. Eddy current brake;
Linear motors: Basic principle of operation and types. End effects & transverse
edge effects. Field analysis & Propulsion force; equivalent circuit.
Stepper motor: Basic construction and principle of operation; types-synchronous
inductor & variable reluctance. Logic circuit for open loop & closed loop
operation; modeling and dynamic analysis.
Switched reluctance motor (SRM): Construction, importance of stator & rotor arc
angles; L- profile, position sensor & indirect rotor position sensing; torque
expression, steady state and dynamic performance.
Permanent magnet, Hysteresis & reluctance motors.
